intent: Keep the theory terms visibly handwritten on a pad in front of the source screen. These are the creator's planning categories, not labels discovered in the agents' records.
source:

**Action:** He identifies the theoretical material the book must carry.

**Dialogue — CURT:**
> These have to be in it. But I don’t want a lecture with a breach behind it.

title: Topics on a legal pad
